description: This file defines FastAPI route handlers related to menu items in a restaurant delivery platform. It includes endpoints for listing menu items for a given restaurant and creating new menu items by restaurant owners.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI's router object used to define API endpoints.

methods.name: list[MenuItemResponse] list_menu_items(restaurant_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to list menu items for a specific restaurant, returning a list of menu item responses.

methods.name: MenuItemResponse create_menu_item( restaurant_id: int, payload: MenuItemCreateRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), owner: User = Depends(require_role(UserRole.restaurant)), )
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new menu item for a restaurant, requiring restaurant owner role, returning the created menu item.

ctags.name: create_menu_item
ctags.signature: ( restaurant_id: int, payload: MenuItemCreateRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), owner: User = Depends(require_role(UserRole.restaurant)), )

ctags.name: list_menu_items
ctags.pattern: /^def list_menu_items(restaurant_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> list[MenuItemResponse]/
